text.p: Vision-Sciences Inc said Tuesday that Steven Barner, its controller and secretary, would resign effective January 6 and that Gerald Lichtenberger would fill the position as acting chief financial officer.
The company said Lichtenberger was also filling the position as executive vice president, chief operating officer and secretary.
Lichtenberger was vice president of Pentax Precision Instrument Corp when Katsumi Oneda was president, the company said. Oneda is now chairman, chief executive and president of Vision-Sciences.
Barner later said that he is leaving on very favorable terms and received a job offer from a manufacturing firm.
